signature_text.description: Acknowledgement text the signer agreed to.

url.description: Direct URL to the full-size signature image.

medium_thumbnail_url.description: URL for a medium-sized thumbnail of the signature image.

large_thumbnail_url.description: URL for a large-sized thumbnail of the signature image.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this signature was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this signature.

login.description: Email address of the user who created this signature.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this signature.

403.description: User does not have permission to view Signatures
